bfff8c87-1974-4442-9963-d09f35cbd79e.title: Aboveground Biomass for Howland Forest, Maine, 2012-2023
bfff8c87-1974-4442-9963-d09f35cbd79e.description: This dataset holds aboveground biomass (AGB) estimates at 10-m spatial resolution for the Howland Research Forest in central Maine for 2012, 2015, 2017, 2021, and 2023. Forest inventory data were collected using 50 fixed-area plot sampling during the summers of 2021, 2023, and 2024.

22913402-bfc7-4951-9165-5e75fdd7f27f.title: Forest Aboveground Biomass for Maine, 2023
22913402-bfc7-4951-9165-5e75fdd7f27f.description: This dataset holds estimates of forest aboveground biomass (AGB) for Maine, USA, in 2023. AGB was estimated using airborne LiDAR data from the USGS 3DEP project and a deep learning convolutional neural network (CNN) model.
